tools.name: get_mcp_guide
tools.description: FortFi MCP capability guide: onboarding paths, pricing, limits, workflows, and full tool catalog. Call first when unsure which tool to use (e.g. market research → discover_tokens, not the Explore UI REST route).

tools.name: get_treasury_context
tools.description: Who am I? Returns treasury email, user id, credential kind/scopes, vault summary, and policy limits for this API key. Call first to confirm you are on the correct account before money-moving tools.

tools.name: list_wallets
tools.description: List FortFi wallets for this account: chain, address, nickname, metadata tags, and default flag. Optional metadataKey/metadataValue filter (exact match). Pass cursor and/or limit to page through large fleets — response becomes { items, nextCursor } when either is set; omit both for the plain array o

tools.name: list_recipients
tools.description: List all allowlisted recipients. Includes cooldown status: `cooldownActive: true` means the recipient cannot yet receive funds (24-hour gate).

tools.name: list_audit_log
tools.description: Recent account activity: one row per money move (sends, swaps, bridges), blocked attempt, or account change (keys, recipients). Money rows and blocked rows carry a confirmationNumber (FF-XXXX-XXXX) the owner can quote to FortFi support. Blocked rows carry the reasons. Pass view: 'full' for every int

tools.name: list_activity_report
tools.description: Treasury activity timeline (JSON) for reconciliation: normalized labels, USD hints, vault scope, and categories. Optional walletId narrows to one vault. Requires reporting:read (or account:read).

tools.name: get_fusion_order_status
tools.description: Track an owned Fusion+ cross-chain order by orderHash. Returns authoritative settlement/refund status, source and destination transactions, receiver, and the real destination token contract.

tools.name: get_policy_limits
tools.description: Current policy limits: per-tx/daily/monthly caps (USDC smallest units). Agent accounts also include agent cap tier limits, maxWallets, and credential access expiry.

tools.name: get_usage_balance
tools.description: Monthly UpTo product balance: cap, used, remaining, and period bounds. Billable writes consume this pool; unused budget is refunded at period end.

tools.name: resend_claim_link
tools.description: Resend the dashboard claim email to contactEmail (MCP agent API key only; keys:manage scope). Use when the original link expired (72h) or was lost. Rate limit: 3/hour.

tools.name: list_funding_wallet_agents
tools.description: List all FortFi agent accounts funded by the same payment wallet as this agent. Use to discover agentLabel / userId when renewing or spawning siblings (treasury multi-agent setups).

tools.name: list_cosigner_memberships
tools.description: Active co-signers on this account.

tools.name: get_cosigner_rules
tools.description: Amount-banded cosigner quorum rules for sends and swaps. Below-band amounts auto-execute; matching bands require N cosigner votes.

tools.name: update_cosigner_rules
tools.description: Set cosigner quorum rules (send + swap USD bands). Tightening rules works with the agent key alone. WEAKENING them (lower required cosigners / raise the amount floor) is a GOVERN action: sign a challenge with your funding wallet (challengeId + walletSignature); applies immediately once signed (same

tools.name: list_pending_cosigner_approvals
tools.description: Pending actions that require this account's co-signer approval. Use when this agent is a co-signer on another account.

tools.name: add_recipient
tools.description: Add a payout address to the allowlist. Human developer key (frtfi_hu_* + DA): added with 24h cooldown (no Assist passkey). Agent key (frtfi_ag_*): GOVERN — funding-wallet signature required; then approved immediately.

tools.name: remove_recipient
tools.description: Remove a recipient from the FortFi allowlist (tightening policy — no funding-wallet GOVERN). Human developer key, session, or agent treasury key. Re-sync Turnkey policies in the app so the enclave matches.

tools.name: approve_recipient
tools.description: Approve a recipient still in cooldown (early release). Active cosigners may approve directly. Human passkey owners: use the FortFi app (passkey) or the approval email link; owner bearer keys cannot self-clear. Agent-owned accounts: owner self-approval is GOVERN (funding-wallet signature).

tools.name: validate_recipient_manifest
tools.description: Preview a batch recipient import (max 50 rows). Each row: { address, chainId, nickname? }. Returns ready_new, already_exists, or invalid per line. Read-only.

tools.name: propose_recipient_manifest
tools.description: Apply a validated recipient manifest (human/developer key). Adds new allowlist rows with normal 24h cooldown. Agent keys: use add_recipient per row (GOVERN).

tools.name: validate_payout_manifest
tools.description: Preview batch payroll/payout (max 50 lines). Each line: { recipientId, amountUsdc, memo? }. All recipients must be allowlisted, same chain as fromWalletId, and past cooldown.

tools.name: propose_payout_manifest
tools.description: Execute a validated payout manifest sequentially (one ActionIntent per line). Requires Delegated Access or agent wallet. Set dryRun:true to validate only.

tools.name: propose_transfer
tools.description: Transfer USDC to an allowlisted recipient, OR pay a FortFi invoice by public pid (paymentRequestPid + fromWalletId — amount optional for partial pay). Recipient path requires allowlist approval. Invoice path binds settlement to the pid (Delegated Access / agent accounts execute server-side when conf

tools.name: invite_agent_cosigner
tools.description: Invite a co-signer. Agents: pass cosignerUserId (GOVERN / funding-wallet sign when using an agent API key). Humans: pass email — opens instructions for Security UI passkey provision (Turnkey dual-control with MCP DA).

tools.name: invite_cosigner
tools.description: Alias of invite_agent_cosigner. Humans: email → Security UI. Agents: cosignerUserId.

tools.name: approve_cosigner_action
tools.description: Approve a pending action as co-signer. Use with list_pending_cosigner_approvals.

tools.name: reject_cosigner_action
tools.description: Reject a pending action as co-signer.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Full portfolio summary across all wallets: token balances with USD values, 24h change, and total net worth.

tools.name: get_account_holdings
tools.description: Token holdings for a specific wallet, with USD values and 24h change.

tools.name: review_portfolio
tools.description: Read-only treasury review: allocation buckets (cash, yield, tokens), top holdings, and optional drift vs target weights. Safe for cron — no proposals created.

tools.name: plan_rebalance
tools.description: Read-only rebalance planner toward target weights. Returns suggested legs (swap, yield_deposit, yield_withdraw) without executing. Use propose_* + confirm_proposal to act.

tools.name: discover_tokens
tools.description: Market-wide token discovery on a FortFi chain (USD). Use for trending/gainers/losers/volume/mcap — NOT the browser Explore REST route. Sorts: gainers_1d, gainers_30d, gainers_90d, gainers_365d, losers_1d, losers_30d, losers_90d, losers_365d, market_cap, volume_1d. No 7d or 30d-volume sort exists ups

tools.name: get_token_chart
tools.description: Fetch a compact Zerion chart summary plus deterministic EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, return, max-drawdown, and data-quality analysis. Raw points are omitted by default; set includePoints:true only for visual charting or external analysis. Discontinuous pre-migration/launch samples are excluded from TA

tools.name: screen_tokens
tools.description: Batch cheap-screen tokens across requested chains. Defaults to verified assets, $5M market cap, $50K daily volume, top 30-day performers plus volume leaders, stablecoin removal, and cross-chain deduplication. Returns no proposal.

tools.name: rank_tokens
tools.description: Two-stage token ranking: run the cheap screen, then concurrently fetch deterministic chart evidence only for the strongest candidates. Quick charts 5 candidates over month+3months; standard charts 10 over day+month+3months+year; deep charts 20 and requires explicit opt-in. Returns evidence for user

tools.name: get_swap_routing_guide
tools.description: Returns which swap/bridge tool to use for a given from→to chain pair, with notes on protocols supported.

tools.name: list_token_spender_grants
tools.description: List active ERC-20 token approvals (spender grants) on this account. Useful before proposing a swap to confirm the CoW vault is approved.

tools.name: list_incoming_cosigner_invites
tools.description: List pending co-signer invites sent TO this account (where this account is the invitee). Use to discover accounts you can become a co-signer for.

tools.name: accept_cosigner_invite
tools.description: Accept a pending co-signer invite. After accepting, you will be able to approve/reject pending actions for that account.

tools.name: remove_cosigner
tools.description: Remove an active co-signer from this account. GOVERN action (it shrinks the approver set): via an agent key, sign a challenge with your funding wallet (challengeId + walletSignature); applies immediately once signed.

tools.name: register_backup_governance_wallet
tools.description: Register (or replace) a single backup governance wallet — the agentic equivalent of a backup passkey. Either the funding wallet or this backup can authorize future governance. GOVERN action: sign the challenge with your CURRENT funding wallet (challengeId + walletSignature); applies immediately once

tools.name: remove_backup_governance_wallet
tools.description: Remove the registered backup governance wallet. GOVERN action: sign with your funding wallet (challengeId + walletSignature); applies immediately once signed. After removal, only the funding wallet may authorize governance.

tools.name: list_governance_requests
tools.description: List open governance requests on this account: pending (awaiting signature) and legacy scheduled rows. Use to monitor for unexpected loosening attempts.

tools.name: cancel_governance_change
tools.description: Veto/cancel a pending governance challenge before it is signed and applied. Cancelling TIGHTENS security, so it needs only the agent key (no signature). Also cancels legacy scheduled rows from before immediate-apply parity.

tools.name: revoke_cosigner_invite
tools.description: Revoke a pending outbound co-signer invite before it is accepted.

tools.name: cancel_pending_action
tools.description: Cancel a pending approval that you (the account owner) initiated.

tools.name: propose_rename_account
tools.description: Rename a wallet (account nickname), then call confirm_proposal with the returned proposalId.

tools.name: propose_create_account
tools.description: Create a new wallet on a supported chain. Optional metadata tags (e.g. customer_id). Then call confirm_proposal with the returned proposalId. Agent accounts execute server-side when no cosigners are configured.

tools.name: confirm_proposal
tools.description: Confirm a pending proposal returned by a propose_* tool. Reuses the same policy, risk, allowlist, vault-grant, delegated-authority, and cosign checks as POST /api/mcp/confirm. Returns executed, pending-approval, or passkey-required status.

tools.name: update_wallet_metadata
tools.description: Propose updating wallet metadata tags (flat string key/value pairs; replaces existing tags on confirm). Returns proposalId; call confirm_proposal to apply. Not a money-moving action.

tools.name: preview_swap_quote
tools.description: Optional advanced step: fetch a same-chain swap quote (CoW on EVM, Jupiter on Solana) and return previewQuoteId. Omit previewQuoteId on propose_* to bundle quote+proposal in one call. Does not execute or move funds.

tools.name: preview_bridge_quote
tools.description: Optional advanced step: fetch a cross-chain bridge quote (Fusion+ or deBridge) and return previewQuoteId. Omit previewQuoteId on propose_bridge to bundle quote+proposal in one call.

tools.name: check_trade_allowance
tools.description: Check ERC-20 allowance for an upcoming CoW swap (cow_swap) or Fusion bridge (fusion_bridge). Call before propose_swap / propose_bridge; if insufficient, use propose_token_approve then confirm.

tools.name: propose_token_approve
tools.description: Propose max ERC-20 approval for CoW or Fusion spenders. Returns proposalId: call confirm_proposal before swap/bridge. API keys on a passkey account cannot approve the Fusion (bridge) spender: fusion_bridge returns OWNER_PASSKEY_REQUIRED.

tools.name: propose_swap
tools.description: Propose an EVM CoW swap. Autonomous agents: fetches and binds a quote inline (default), or pass previewQuoteId from preview_swap_quote for a two-step review. confirm always signs the bound quote — same principle as FortFi Assist. Human session MCP: confirm requires passkey in the app.

tools.name: propose_solana_swap
tools.description: Propose a Solana Jupiter swap. Autonomous agents: inline quote by default, or previewQuoteId for two-step review. confirm signs the bound quote.

tools.name: propose_bridge
tools.description: Propose a Fusion+ or deBridge cross-chain swap. FortFi resolves chain-specific verified token contracts from sellSymbol/buySymbol; optional token addresses are mismatch assertions, never routing overrides. Inline quote by default, or use previewQuoteId for two-step review. Agent wallets execute on c

tools.name: list_yield_markets
tools.description: Open Morpho yield discovery by chain with discovered, policyEligible, manuallyCurated, executionReady, and eligibilityReasons. Default minimum TVL is $500K everywhere (listing, policy, Turnkey). executionReady means TVL qualifies and you have a wallet on that chain; POLICY_SYNC_RECOMMENDED is adviso

tools.name: list_yield_positions
tools.description: Active Morpho yield positions with per-vault valueUsd, earnedUsd (Morpho pnlUsd), netApy, and a summary block. summary.cumulativeEarnedUsd matches Morpho pnl on the open vaults when the ledger cannot explain the balance. A deposit missing from the ledger is principal, not earnings. Use at the start

tools.name: get_yield_market_detail
tools.description: Evidence for one Morpho vault: current net APY/TVL, historical APY and TVL series, period statistics, quality flags, allocation, instant-withdrawal liquidity, separated eligibility/readiness status, and timestamp. Rank on evidence.apy.medianPercent: the raw series contains upstream artifacts (points

tools.name: rank_yield_markets
tools.description: Batch-rank Morpho markets using current net APY, APY median/average/range/volatility, TVL trend/drawdown, vault age, curation, instant-withdrawal liquidity, warnings, and current-user execution eligibility. Results are ordered by current net APY, which is a spot rate that spikes: re-rank on evidence

tools.name: propose_yield_deposit
tools.description: Propose Morpho vault deposit, then call confirm_proposal. With Delegated Access / agent key this executes server-side when policy permits. Use list_yield_markets for vaultAddress.

tools.name: propose_yield_withdraw
tools.description: Propose Morpho vault withdraw, then call confirm_proposal. With Delegated Access this executes server-side when policy permits. Use list_yield_positions for vaultAddress.

tools.name: list_polymarket_markets
tools.description: List active Polymarket prediction markets on Polygon with volume, liquidity, and outcome prices.

tools.name: search_polymarket_markets
tools.description: Search Polymarket markets by question text.

tools.name: rank_polymarket_markets
tools.description: Rank Polymarket markets by volume, liquidity, or 24h volume.

tools.name: get_polymarket_market
tools.description: Get a Polymarket market by conditionId with optional outcome price history from the public CLOB API.

tools.name: list_polymarket_positions
tools.description: List Polymarket outcome token positions for a Polygon wallet. walletId is required.

tools.name: propose_polymarket_buy
tools.description: Propose buying Polymarket outcome shares, then call confirm_proposal. Requires Polygon wallet.

tools.name: propose_polymarket_sell
tools.description: Propose selling Polymarket outcome shares (redeem collateral), then call confirm_proposal.

tools.name: propose_polymarket_redeem
tools.description: Propose redeeming winning shares from a resolved Polymarket market (CTF on Polygon), then call confirm_proposal.

tools.name: list_hyperliquid_markets
tools.description: List Hyperliquid perpetual markets with live mark/mid/oracle prices, funding, open interest, and 24h volume. Public data; no proposal.

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_market
tools.description: Get a Hyperliquid perp market by symbol with mark/funding context and optional candle history.

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_order_book
tools.description: Live order book for one Hyperliquid perp (core or HIP-3, e.g. BTC or xyz:NVDA) or, with market=spot, one spot pair: up to 20 levels a side, mid, spread, and USD resting within 0.5%, 1% and 2% of mid. Pass sizeUsd to see the average fill and price impact of a market buy and sell of that size. Use it

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_predicted_funding
tools.description: Next funding rate per Hyperliquid perp, per hour and annualized, with Binance and Bybit for the same coin and the gap between them. Positive means longs pay shorts. Without symbols: core coins sorted by the size of the Hyperliquid rate. HIP-3 coins (xyz:, …) need symbols and return the current hourl

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_open_interest_history
tools.description: Hourly open interest for one Hyperliquid perp (core or HIP-3), in coins and dollars, with price and funding at each hour, plus the change over 1 hour, 24 hours and 7 days. Hyperliquid keeps no open interest history; FortFi records it every hour from 2026-11-05.

tools.name: list_hyperliquid_symbol_master
tools.description: Security master for Hyperliquid perps: symbol, dex, desk label, short symbol, display name, asset class (crypto/equity/commodity/fx/index/pre_ipo), plus live volume and funding. Default scope=core; pass scope=all for HIP-3.

tools.name: rank_hyperliquid_markets
tools.description: Rank Hyperliquid perp markets by 24h volume, pctChange, or funding. Returns dex + assetClass tags. Default scope=core; pass scope=all for HIP-3. Cheap filter only — use screen_hyperliquid_markets for breakout TA.

tools.name: screen_hyperliquid_markets
tools.description: Breakout screener for Hyperliquid perps: min volume filter, rank, HL candle TA (RSI, MACD, Bollinger). Returns dex + assetClass tags and long/short/neutral bias. Default scope=core; scope=all for HIP-3. Never creates proposals.

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_cross_section
tools.description: Rank a Hyperliquid perp universe by trailing return in one call, for a dollar-neutral long/short book. tools.name: run_hyperliquid_research_backtest_spec
tools.description: Run an out-of-sample backtest from a Strategy Spec JSON (universe + rank factor or named pattern + portfolio rules). Deterministic; reads hl_research_* Postgres. tools.description: Read the loss cap on a Hyperliquid wallet: the max loss in percent, whether it is armed or tripped, the balance it was set at, and (live) how much the wallet has lost or made since. Deposits and withdrawals do not count as gains or losses. Returns lossCap null when none is set.

tools.description: Add a loss cap to a Hyperliquid wallet, or lower the one it has. tools.name: get_wallet_scoreboard
tools.description: Scoreboard for a Hyperliquid wallet from Hyperliquid's public data: balance, P&L in dollars and percent, win rate (closed trades that beat their fees), trades, fees, volume, worst drop, the loss cap, and BTC buy-and-hold over the same window (no leverage) as the bar to beat. Same numbers anyone can

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_research_data_stats
tools.description: Row counts and last ingest time for hl_research_* tables (candles, funding, symbols). Use before backtests to confirm data freshness.

tools.name: list_strategy_presets
tools.description: List FortFi autonomous Hyperliquid strategies (house presets) with their published backtest: out-of-sample return, Sharpe and drawdown at 1x, walk-forward windows, every leverage scenario, tested leverage (start_strategy accepts these), high-risk leverage (owner passkey only), and the minimum accoun

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: List strategies running on your Hyperliquid accounts (presets and copy trades): status, leverage, cap, next rebalance, and whether an API key started it. Stopped strategies are hidden unless includeStopped is true.

tools.name: get_strategy
tools.description: Get one strategy with its last 20 runs (each run lists the orders it placed and their result).

tools.description: Top Hyperliquid accounts to copy, from Hyperliquid's public leaderboard. Only accounts over $25k that traded this month and are profitable all-time. Returns end value, return, worst drop, costs, the leader's own numbers and an equity curve. An estimate from sampled

tools.name: list_copy_leader_fills
tools.description: What a Hyperliquid address traded recently: fills since N minutes ago, grouped per market (opens, closes, flips, dollars bought and sold, profit taken) plus the latest fills. Poll it to follow a leader between your runs.

tools.name: get_copy_trade_wallet
tools.description: Deep dive on any Hyperliquid address: account value, leverage, open positions with share of book, PnL and volume for day, week, month and all time, and a copy preview per leverage cap (which positions would be copied, coverage, and the minimum account size so each copied position is at least $10).

tools.name: start_strategy
tools.description: Start a house preset on a hyperliquid-mainnet wallet and place its first orders. Leverage cap

tools.name: update_strategy
tools.description: Resize a strategy or copy trade: raise or lower its leverage (offered levels only) or allocation cap. Moving into a high-risk level needs acceptHighRisk: true. The loss cap can be added or lowered, never raised or removed (OWNER_PASSKEY_REQUIRED).

tools.name: pause_strategy
tools.description: Pause a strategy. Positions stay open; no more orders until resumed.

tools.name: resume_strategy
tools.description: Resume a paused strategy. An API key can only resume a strategy it started; others need the owner in the app.

tools.name: stop_strategy
tools.description: Stop a strategy and close every position it opened (cash out). Positions it did not open are left alone.

tools.name: rebalance_strategy_now
tools.description: Run a strategy's rebalance now instead of waiting for its schedule. Returns the run outcome.

tools.name: list_hyperliquid_positions
tools.description: List open Hyperliquid perp positions and margin summary for a hyperliquid-mainnet wallet (its address is used on the L1 order book).

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_balances
tools.description: Get Hyperliquid wallet balances: L1 perps margin (withdrawable), HL Spot USDC (MoonPay HyperCore lands here), and HyperEVM USDC/HYPE. Also returns a `perps` aggregate over open positions: openPositionCount, unrealizedPnlUsd, entryNotionalUsd, and unrealizedPnlPct (null when nothing is open).

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_trading_desk
tools.description: One-shot Hyperliquid trading desk snapshot for agent loops: margin, balances, positions, open orders, recent fills, and a `performance` block with unrealizedPnlUsd, unrealizedPnlPct, entryNotionalUsd, openPositionCount, and realizedPnlUsdRecentFills. Prefer this over many separate reads every 30-60

tools.name: list_hyperliquid_open_orders
tools.description: List resting Hyperliquid orders including SL/TP triggers for a wallet.

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_user_fills
tools.description: Recent Hyperliquid trade fills with closedPnl per fill. Use for P&L review and trade history (up to 2000 from HL).

tools.name: propose_hyperliquid_perp_open
tools.description: Propose opening a Hyperliquid perp position. Runs FortFi perp policy (max leverage, max notional) and rejects non-hyperliquid-mainnet wallets. Optional marginMode picks cross or isolated margin. Returns a proposalId for confirm_proposal.

tools.name: propose_hyperliquid_perp_close
tools.description: Propose closing a Hyperliquid perp position (reduce-only). Omit size to close the whole position. Returns a proposalId for confirm_proposal.

tools.name: propose_hyperliquid_perp_modify
tools.description: Propose modifying an open Hyperliquid perp position: its stop-loss / take-profit and/or its leverage. tools.name: cancel_hyperliquid_orders
tools.description: Propose cancelling resting Hyperliquid orders (limit orders and SL/TP triggers) on one market. Pass oids from list_hyperliquid_open_orders, or omit oids to cancel every resting order on that symbol. Moves no money, but cancelling a stop loss removes protection, so it follows the normal confirm_propo

tools.name: propose_hyperliquid_deposit
tools.description: Propose moving HyperEVM USDC into Hyperliquid perp margin (top up). Set perpDex for HIP-3 desks (xyz, io, para). Returns proposalId; execute with confirm_proposal (server-side when Delegated Access or agent credential).

tools.name: propose_hyperliquid_withdraw
tools.description: Propose moving Hyperliquid perp USDC to the owner's own HyperEVM wallet (same address; perp to HL Spot, then sendAsset to the USDC system address). Funds cannot go to any other recipient. Returns proposalId; human confirms with passkey via Perps Withdraw to HyperEVM or confirm_proposal.

tools.name: propose_hyperliquid_spot_to_perp
tools.description: Propose moving USDC from HL Spot into core perps margin (required after MoonPay HyperCore on-ramp). Returns proposalId; human confirms via Perps Deposit to tradable balance or confirm_proposal.

tools.name: propose_hyperliquid_send_asset
tools.description: Move USDC between Hyperliquid margin desks without HyperEVM (any perp book: core, xyz, io, para, mkts, …, or spot → any perp desk). Use list_hyperliquid_balances perpDesks[].dex for valid dex ids.

tools.name: list_hyperliquid_outcome_markets
tools.description: List Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets on the same account as perps. Prices are quote-micro (650000 = $0.65) from exchange mids. volumeUsd is 0 because outcomeMeta does not publish volume.

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_outcome_market
tools.description: One HIP-4 outcome market. id is the numeric outcome id. Optional walletId reads that Hyperliquid account's share balance.

tools.name: propose_hyperliquid_outcome_order
tools.description: Propose a HIP-4 buy or sell on the Hyperliquid account. size is micro-USDC collateral (10000000 = $10). limitPrice is quote-micro. Runs outcome policy (no leverage, max notional) before any signature. Confirm with confirm_proposal.

tools.name: list_hyperliquid_spot_markets
tools.description: List Hyperliquid spot pairs (you own the coin, no leverage, no funding). tools.description: Turn off the trailing or time stop FortFi manages on a position. Stops already on the book stay where they are.

tools.name: list_hyperliquid_managed_exits
tools.description: Trailing and time stops FortFi manages: settings, best price so far, the stop it last placed, and a note when something stopped it. includeEnded=true adds finished ones.

tools.name: propose_hyperliquid_carry
tools.description: Funding carry in one call: buy the coin on spot, then short the same size on its perp, so price moves cancel out and the short earns funding while funding is positive. Both legs run through the normal policy, grant, loss cap and audit checks (the key needs propose_hyperliquid_spot_order and propose_

tools.name: create_checkout_session
tools.description: Create a per-customer checkout session: resolves (or provisions) the customer's own vault from your externalCustomerId, mints a payment request that settles into it, and returns checkoutUrl + x402Url. The paid webhook then carries customer identity. Price from productSlug or ad-hoc amountUsd.

tools.name: create_payment_request
tools.description: Create a shareable payment request for a vault. Returns pid, paymentUrl, and qrPayload for humans or agents.

tools.name: get_payment_request
tools.description: Get a payment request by internal id or public pid, including settlement attempts.

tools.name: list_payment_requests
tools.description: List payment requests for the authenticated account.

tools.name: cancel_payment_request
tools.description: Cancel an open payment request with no verified settlement.

tools.name: extend_payment_request
tools.description: Extend an open payment request expiry (default extension window in days).

tools.name: pay_payment_request_x402
tools.description: Pay an open FortFi invoice via x402 EIP-3009 from a governed Turnkey vault. Requires Delegated Access on human developer keys or an agent account. Base mainnet first.

tools.name: list_payment_sales
tools.description: Merchant view: paid and partially paid invoices on your collection vaults (what you sold). Includes payer, method, and settlement details.

tools.name: list_payment_purchases
tools.description: Buyer view: FortFi checkouts your vaults paid (what you bought). Matches settlements by payer wallet address across your fleet.

tools.name: create_payment_product
tools.description: Create a persistent product checkout link (/pay/p/{slug}). Each visit mints a fresh payment request. One webhook endpoint receives paid events for all products.

tools.name: list_payment_products
tools.description: List persistent product checkout links for the account.

tools.name: get_payment_product
tools.description: Get a payment product by internal id or public slug.

tools.name: create_merchant_webhook
tools.description: Register a webhook URL. FortFi generates a signing secret (returned once) for the merchant to verify HMAC on incoming POSTs. Not per-product — one endpoint receives all paid events.

tools.name: list_merchant_webhooks
tools.description: List registered webhook endpoints (secrets are never returned).

tools.name: list_merchant_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: List webhook delivery log. Use status=failed for dead-letter queue rows. Filter by paymentRequestId to find deliveries for one checkout.

tools.name: replay_merchant_webhook_delivery
tools.description: Replay a dead-lettered or failed webhook delivery after fixing your endpoint. Re-sends the same event id and body for idempotent handlers.

tools.name: send_merchant_webhook_test
tools.description: Send a signed webhook.test event to an endpoint.

tools.name: search_vaults
tools.description: Parent-treasury vault inventory search (treasury credential + keys:manage + wallets:read). Matches nicknames, wallet IDs, addresses, external customer IDs, credential names, and prefixes. Never returns raw bearer keys.

tools.name: search_credentials
tools.description: Parent-treasury key-centric credential search (treasury credential + keys:manage + wallets:read). Complements search_vaults. Never returns raw bearer keys.

tools.name: create_vault_credential
tools.description: Mint a vault-scoped credential for an existing wallet (treasury + keys:manage). Returns bearerKey once when agentPublicKey is omitted. Requires FORTFI_VAULT_CREDENTIALS_ENABLED.

tools.name: update_vault_credential
tools.description: Atomically replace a vault credential's name, access mode, grants, and expiry (treasury + keys:manage). Revoked credentials cannot be updated.

tools.name: revoke_vault_credential
tools.description: Revoke a vault-scoped credential (treasury + keys:manage). Idempotent if already revoked.

tools.name: create_provisioning_job
tools.description: Bulk-provision up to 20 customer vaults per job (treasury + keys:manage + wallets:write). Requires idempotencyKey in args. Poll get_provisioning_job until terminal; bearer secrets reveal once on first terminal GET.

tools.name: get_provisioning_job
tools.description: Poll a bulk provisioning job (treasury + keys:manage + wallets:read). bearerKey appears once when secretsDelivery is revealed.

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description: Create or sync one customer vault synchronously (treasury + wallets:write). Idempotent on externalCustomerId + namespace + chain. Returns wallet address immediately; Turnkey wallet creation may take a few seconds on first call.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_hyperliquid_order_book" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Live order book for one Hyperliquid perp (core or HIP-3, e.g. BTC or xyz:NVDA): up to 20 levels a side, mid, spread, and USD resting within 0.5%, 1% and 2% of mid. Pass sizeUsd to see the average fill and price impact of a market buy and sell of that size. Use it before sizing an order or to compare" → after: "Live order book for one Hyperliquid perp (core or HIP-3, e.g. BTC or xyz:NVDA) or, with market=spot, one spot pair: up to 20 levels a side, mid, spread, and USD resting within 0.5%, 1% and 2% of mid. Pass sizeUsd to see the average fill and price impact of a market buy and sell of that size. Use it "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
